answer_1.quote: We propose a novel method, PCLL, to enhance generative replay for building lifelong NLU modules of ToD systems.
answer_1.outputs: Pseudo samples for intent detection and slot filling tasks are generated using a CVAE-based generator conditioned on prompts, e.g., 'For an utterance from the BANKING task, "I already have one of your cards, how do I link them?" has the following intent', followed by the generated intent.

answer_2.quote: We use the distinct score Dist-n to measure the proportion of unique n-grams in the generated pseudo samples' inputs (n=1,2,3,4).
